decision.summary: Tenant reports a broken LG washing machine and offers to replace it with their own. This needs landlord consent because it is an appliance replacement or alteration, not a straightforward repair. I asked the landlord, told the tenant not to buy yet, and put the ticket on hold to 30 July.
